title: test(qa): cite delegation-of-duty.dogfood.test.ts as the grant-validity-window proof
body:
Fixes #9377

## What

Two mechanical lines, both required by the #7976 mutual-attribution contract:

1. `packages/qa/dogfood/test/delegation-of-duty.dogfood.test.ts` header gains `// authz-row: grant-validity-window` — the proof file now claims the row it proves.
2. `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts`'s `grant-validity-window` row gains `proof: 'delegation-of-duty.dogfood.test.ts'` — the row now cites the file back.

No test content changed, no risk classification changed, and `state: 'enforced'` is untouched — this is purely an attribution upgrade from "unit-proven, e2e exists but uncited" to a cited end-to-end proof, exactly as #9377 frames it.

**Follow-up (PM review):** the row's own `note` still ended with a clause saying the proof was "not cited here ... filed as a follow-up" — stale the moment the citation above landed. Corrected that trailing clause only (now: "exists and is now cited (#9377) ... the #7976 mutual-attribution contract is satisfied"); the rest of the note (HIGH_RISK reasoning, unit pins, the #8802 note) is untouched.

## Why this is safe to do mechanically

`checkLedger`'s `attribution` option (`packages/verify/src/conformance.ts`) asserts the row <-> proof pairing in **both** directions: the cited proof file must claim the row, and every claim must be reciprocated by a real row that cites that file back. A wrong or missing half fails the build rather than shipping silently.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/delegation-of-duty.dogfood.test.ts test/authz-conformance.test.ts` — 2 files, 32/32 passed, including `authz-conformance.test.ts`'s `#7976 — row ↔ proof attribution is mutual > every row that cites a proof is CLAIMED by it (baseline lock)`, which is the real `checkLedger` call running against this PR's own matrix + proof file. Re-ran after the note-wording follow-up commit — still 32/32 (prose-only change, checkLedger unaffected as expected).
- Reverse-verification (predicted before running): removed the `authz-row: grant-validity-window` header line only, re-ran `authz-conformance.test.ts -t 'is a sound conformance ledger'` — failed exactly as predicted, naming the row:
  ```
  AssertionError: grant-validity-window: proof does not claim this row — add `authz-row: grant-validity-window` to delegation-of-duty.dogfood.test.ts, or stop citing it
  ```
  Restored from the committed state (`git checkout HEAD -- <path>`), re-ran the same test — green again.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck` — clean.
- Full workspace build (`pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./packages/*/*'`) — 70/70 tasks successful, then re-measured on the built closure:
  - `pnpm check:type-check-coverage` / `pnpm check:type-check-debt --re-measure` — OK, 1926 raw tsc errors total, none above the recorded ledger numbers.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:empty-state`, `check:liveness`, `check:strictness-ledger`, `check:variant-docs` — all green (dogfood liveness family).
- `pnpm check:test-source-alias`, `check:type-source-resolution` — green.
- `node scripts/docs-audit/check-affected-docs.mjs` — green.
- `pnpm check:query-options-erasure`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:where-matcher` — green (test-file-edit convention family; no new doubles/matchers introduced by this change); re-confirmed after the follow-up commit.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on all changed files — clean (re-run after the follow-up commit too).
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` — clean.

Head commit: `2e13bcd1f`.
